recommended_areas.why: best first-time historic cluster and walkable landmarks

recommended_areas.name: Yanta
recommended_areas.why: good for museum, pagoda, and theme-based planning

recommended_areas.name: Qujiang
recommended_areas.why: better for family, night lighting, and bigger modern venues

transport: Keep old-city walls and Muslim Quarter on the same day when possible.
Use one strong history cluster per day instead of spreading sites too widely.
Terracotta Warriors should usually stand as a separate half-day or full-day excursion.
bad_weather_fallbacks: Swap wall walking and broad outdoor parks for museums, pagoda interiors, or indoor heritage venues.
Use covered dining streets and malls to reduce exposed walking.

leisure.pace_note: Xi'an is strongest when you keep the day tightly anchored around one history cluster.

family.pace_note: Give the family one flagship attraction and keep the rest lighter.

food.pace_note: Pair food neighborhoods with nearby monuments rather than long-distance detours.

theme.pace_note: Choose one dynasty or historical theme and build depth around it.

suggestions: Good day for city-wall or pagoda-based outdoor highlights.
Use history museums and food streets as weather-safe anchors.
